title: Length Reduction Taken off a Closing Hotel Night
content:
A length reduction is taken off according to the nights the reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range covers, counted from the arrival date to the departure date. Where the reservation covers 7 nights or more, the length reduction is 12 percent. Where it covers 4 nights or more but fewer than 7, the length reduction is 6 percent. Where it covers fewer than 4 nights, the length reduction is nil.

The count is of the nights the reservation covers between the arrival date and the departure date. The nights so far posted to the folio do not enter it, nor does the number of rooms held.

**Points of judgement.**

*A reservation arriving on the 2nd and departing on the 9th.* It covers 7 nights, so the reduction is 12 percent.

*Arriving on the 2nd and departing on the 8th.* It covers 6 nights, so the reduction is 6 percent.

*Arriving on the 2nd and departing on the 6th.* It covers 4 nights, which is the foot of that band, so the reduction is still 6 percent.

*Arriving on the 2nd and departing on the 5th.* It covers 3 nights, so the reduction is nil.

*A reservation covering 8 nights of which only 5 are so far posted to the folio.* The nights covered are 8, so the reduction is 12 percent; the nights posted do not enter the count.

*The base this reduction acts on is 250.00 USD and the reservation covers 8 nights.* The reduction of 12 percent leaves 220.00 USD, rounded to the cent.
